extracted.name: Marshmallow Log
extracted.description: Colored marshmallows, graham cracker crumbs, condensed milk, walnuts and candied cherries are shaped into a log, covered in coconut and chilled.
instruction_lines: Sprinkle coconut evenly on a sheet of waxed paper.

In a medium bowl, stir together marshmallows, graham cracker crumbs, condensed milk, walnuts, and cherries. Shape into a log; place on waxed paper and roll in coconut. Wrap with waxed paper and refrigerate until firm.
